data.narrative:
Monarch Quantum is a Growth-stage quantum computing company founded by Dr. Timothy Day (Stanford-trained physicist, former Daylight Solutions co-founder) alongside CTO Michael Pushkarsky, President/CFO Bryan Taylor, and COO Eric Takeuchi. The company has raised $115M+ in capital and contracts. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comps (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable to this valuation. Using total capital raised of $115M as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage progression to the next funding round yields an implied valuation of $138M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while 8 same-sector private peers exist, none meet the criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier, leaving insufficient datapoints (need ≥3) for meaningful median comparison. Reliance on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $117M to $159M, with a median of $138M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include the narrow applicability of stage-progression metrics to early quantum computing commercialization and the absence of a tight peer cohort for cross-validation. Resolution of technical feasibility and path-to-revenue remain primary value drivers not captured in this framework.
